finalBudget.scope: Actual VRChat SDK preprocess result on a build clone; not an upload

disabled.label: Foot/toe tracking and animation
disabled.remoteImpact: Remote viewers no longer receive toe axis values or toe control toggles; the remote toe PhysBone/animation state can fall back to its default.

disabled.label: Nemesis wand and projectile state
disabled.remoteImpact: Remote viewers no longer receive wand take/reload/aim/fire/selection state. Non-local clients may render the default wand or omit transient effects.

disabled.label: Sleep, crouch and Supine state
disabled.remoteImpact: Remote viewers no longer receive sleep/supine, crouch pose, root-height or foot-anchor state. This group is optional and is normally absent from the minimal FullFT test avatar.

disabled.label: Legacy facial preset selector
disabled.remoteImpact: Remote viewers no longer receive the locally selected legacy facial set. The source drivers are local-only, so remote clients otherwise stay at set 0. Current FaceLock/Fasial result state remains protected.

disabled.label: Nonessential FullFT cohabitation controls
disabled.remoteImpact: Remote viewers no longer receive the legacy manual FaceLock/Fasial preset selection, shield toggle, jump-collider toggle, face-petting gesture state, head-petting toggle, or tail-collider toggle. High-frequency FT/v2 tracking, the eight VRCFT controls, MF3 geometry, and placement remain direct.

checks.name: FT exact manifest names and types
FT is fully direct (161 physical bits)
MorphForge geometry is 56 bits and direct when required
MorphForge placement is 14 bits and direct when required
Local-only FullFT parameters are not represented
